tools.name: me_get
tools.description: The account this API key belongs to, the key in use, its scopes, and the credit balance available to spend.

tools.name: project_list
tools.description: List projects you can file documents into.

tools.name: project_create
tools.description: Create a project (pass team_id for a team project; parent_id for a sub-project of a top-level project — same owner, one level deep).

tools.name: document_list
tools.description: List documents, newest first. One row per language version; siblings share language_group_id.

tools.name: document_get
tools.description: Document metadata + its language group.

tools.name: document_create
tools.description: Create a document from inline text/markdown/html and fan out target languages.

tools.name: document_update
tools.description: Update document metadata (title / category / project filing).

tools.name: document_delete
tools.description: Delete ONE language version of a document.

tools.name: document_add_languages
tools.description: Add target-language sibling versions to a document (grows its language group). Idempotent — languages already in the group are skipped.

tools.name: document_content_get
tools.description: Read content as json | markdown | html | strings (binary formats: use the REST content endpoint).

tools.name: document_attach_resources
tools.description: Attach/detach glossaries + style-guide versions ([] = detach all of that kind).

tools.name: document_resync_source
tools.description: Re-parse the document from its STORED source file and re-align blocks (unchanged blocks keep translations). The file owns sources: block_update edits are NOT in the file, so a resync overwrites them — resync when the source file changed, not after block edits.

tools.name: strings_import
tools.description: Import a Transept Strings corpus (.tstrings.json shape). Locales: explicit params win; with none named the corpus header target_locales apply (no locales anywhere → sync no_target_languages). A single-locale import is ONE version row carrying the corpus (language_group_id null until more locales joi

tools.name: strings_reimport
tools.description: Re-submit the WHOLE current corpus against an existing master: the server diffs by unit id and answers with {units, versions[], delta_block_ids} — pass delta_block_ids VERBATIM as group_run_start.block_ids to run only the delta. Unchanged units keep their translations. Synchronous, bills nothing.

tools.name: block_update
tools.description: Edit a block's SOURCE content (Slate JSON). Note: edits live on the block, not in the stored source file — a later document_resync_source re-parses the file and overwrites them.

tools.name: block_translation_update
tools.description: Edit a translation (Slate JSON); it stays active and feeds TM.

tools.name: processing_job_get
tools.description: Poll an import job — the id returned by strings_import (or a REST file upload / Figma import). Runs are NOT processing jobs: poll those with run_get.

tools.name: workflow_list
tools.description: Saved workflows (ids go into run_start.workflow_id).

tools.name: workflow_template_list
tools.description: Built-in templates (ids go into run_start.template_id).

tools.name: run_estimate
tools.description: Price a run (free, no side effects). Costs are in credits.

tools.name: run_start
tools.description: Start a workflow run. BILLS CREDITS — without confirm:true this only returns the estimate and starts nothing.

tools.name: run_get
tools.description: Poll a run: status, progress, and (when gate_pending) the review-gate digest.

tools.name: run_list
tools.description: List runs, newest first. Paged like document_list: {data, has_more, next_cursor}.

tools.name: run_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a run (idempotent — answers with the resulting status, so an already-terminal run reads as what it already was).

tools.name: run_gate_approve
tools.description: Approve a review gate. Continuing downstream steps BILLS CREDITS — without confirm:true this only returns what continuing will cost (up to max_credits) and continues nothing. Omit block_ids to continue over ALL blocks the run processed; pass a subset to continue only those; pass [] to close the gate

tools.name: run_gate_acknowledge
tools.description: Dismiss a review gate without continuing.

tools.name: group_run_estimate
tools.description: Price a multi-language fan-out (free).

tools.name: group_run_start
tools.description: Run a workflow across many languages. BILLS CREDITS — without confirm:true this only returns the estimate.

tools.name: group_run_get
tools.description: Poll a group run: rollup + per-language lanes.

tools.name: group_run_list
tools.description: List group runs, newest first.

tools.name: group_run_cancel
tools.description: Cancel every still-active lane of a group run.

tools.name: glossary_list
tools.description: List glossaries (yours + your teams’).

tools.name: glossary_get
tools.description: One glossary with its terms.

tools.name: glossary_create
tools.description: Create a glossary (optionally seed terms).

tools.name: glossary_terms_add
tools.description: Add terms in bulk; the answer is counts.

tools.name: styleguide_list
tools.description: List style guides with their ACTIVE version id (what documents consume).

tools.name: styleguide_get
tools.description: One style guide incl. the active version content.

tools.name: tm_query
tools.description: Query translation memory (hybrid retrieval; free).

tools.name: tm_import
tools.description: Import a TMX/XLIFF file’s text into translation memory (free; async embeddings).

tools.name: webhook_list
tools.description: List outgoing webhook endpoints (no secrets).

tools.name: webhook_create
tools.description: Register an outgoing webhook. The response carries the signing secret ONCE.

tools.name: webhook_delete
tools.description: Delete an outgoing webhook endpoint.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "webhook_list" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Register an outgoing webhook. The response carries the signing secret ONCE.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: document_content_get, run_get · Private data: me_get, project_list, document_list, document_get, document_create, document_update, document_delete, document_add_languages, document_content_get, document_attach_resources, document_resync_source, block_update, processing_job_get, styleguide_list, tm_import, webhook_list, webhook_create · Public sink: document_list, strings_reimport, processing_job_get, webhook_list, webhook_create, webhook_delete · Destructive: document_delete, strings_reimport, run_estimate, run_start, run_get, run_list, run_cancel, run_gate_approve, run_gate_acknowledge, group_run_estimate, group_run_start, group_run_get, group_run_list, group_run_cancel, webhook_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: document_content_get, run_get · Private data: me_get, project_list, document_list, document_get, document_create, document_update, document_delete, document_add_languages, document_content_get, document_attach_resources, document_resync_source, block_update, processing_job_get, styleguide_list, tm_import, webhook_list, webhook_create · Public sink: document_list, strings_reimport, processing_job_get, webhook_list, webhook_create, webhook_delete · Destructive: document_delete, strings_reimport, run_estimate, run_start, run_get, run_list, run_cancel, run_gate_approve, run_gate_acknowledge, group_run_estimate, group_run_start, group_run_get, group_run_list, group_run_cancel, webhook_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
